items.w: אל תתחר במרעים אל תקנא בעשי עולה
items.title: ENVY
items.quote: Don’t be disturbed by bad people. Don’t be envious of wrongdoers.
items.text: Don’t let yourself be tempted to associate with wrongdoers and emulate them because of their apparent good fortune. It won’t last.

items.w: כי כחציר מהרה ימלו וכירק דשא יבולון
items.quote: For like grass they will be quickly cut down. Like vegetation they will wither.

items.w: בטח ביהוה ועשה טוב שכן ארץ ורעה אמונה
items.title: BITACHON
items.quote: Trust in Hashem and do good. Dwell in the land and nourish [your] faith.
items.text: Maintain your trust in Hashem despite difficulties; you will be rewarded with security and happiness.

items.w: והתענג על יהוה ויתן לך משאלת לבך
items.title: DELIGHT
items.quote: Delight in Hashem. He will grant you the desires of your heart.
items.text: Serve Hashem with joy in your heart, for you are pleasing Him.

items.w: הרף מאף ועזב חמה אל תתחר אך להרע
items.title: RESENTMENT
items.quote: Let go of anger and forsake resentment. Don’t let yourself be disturbed, for [such feelings] bring only harm.
items.text: You will only harm yourself if you indulge in anger and resentment. If you focus on what is good in your life, your attitude will be its own reward.

items.title: INTEGRITY
items.quote: The evildoer borrows but does not repay.
items.text: Don’t borrow unless you really need to; if you have borrowed, treat your debt as a holy obligation.

items.title: GENEROSITY
items.quote: but the righteous person is a benefactor and a giver.
items.text: Be generous and helpful to others, without undue concern about being reimbursed.

items.w: מיהוה מצעדי גבר כוננו ודרכו יחפץ
items.title: LOVE OF THE RIGHTEOUS
items.quote: From Hashem the righteous man’s footsteps are made firm and Hashem is pleased with his way.
items.text: Even though the righteous man may seem to be at a disadvantage in this world, Hashem loves him and supports him every step of his way through life.

items.w: סור מרע ועשה טוב ושכן לעולם
items.title: THE FUTURE
items.quote: Turn away from evil and do good. You will then live [in peace] all your life.
items.text: Hold fast to your principles in spite of difficulties and you will be able to look ahead to a fulfilled life.

items.w: ותשועת צדיקים מיהוה מעוזם בעת צרה
items.title: YESHUAH
items.quote: The yeshuah of the righteous is from Hashem, their stronghold in time of distress.
items.text: The future of the righteous is assured because their yeshuah is a certain promise from Him.
